svg.title: Kasir POS stack
svg.desc: Frontend: React 18, Vite, Tailwind 3, Zustand. Backend: Fastify 5, Node 22, MCP server, Server-sent events. Data: PostgreSQL 16, Drizzle ORM. AI: Deterministic analytics engine, MCP for any agent. Ops: Docker Compose, Caddy, Vitest
svg.text: Versions as pinned in the project.
